title: Map Claude assistant features to the live Render bridge
goal: Identify which capabilities exist only on the Claude operations branch, which exist on the deployed bridge branch, and propose one minimal read-only integration test. Do not deploy or write client data.
doneCriteria: Document the branch and deployment boundary.
List the smallest modules needed for one read-only end-to-end test.
Record verification commands and observed results.
Present deployment or live-write steps for Chance approval rather than executing them.
constraints: Do not deploy or change Render environment variables.
Do not write to JobNimbus, Gmail, Quo, Drive, Calendar, or Twilio.
Do not commit secrets, runtime exports, transcripts, or client PII.

log.note: claimed; fetched and mapped remote branch heads
documented unrelated branch histories, route ownership, and a minimal read-only comparison test

result.summary: Mapped the operations-assistant and live-bridge boundaries. Recommended retaining the live bridge as the production API shell and porting one read-only capability at a time.
result.verification: Fetched both remote heads; inspected package.json, render.yaml, bridge route surfaces, and confirmed git merge-base exits 1. Clean npm ci passed. The self-test passed, but npm run check and npm run sweep:fixture exposed two missing report modules; a separate Claude task records the blocker. No deploys or live writes were performed.
